Method of Attack: Utilizes a malicious sideloaded DLL (ffmpeg.dll - SHA256: 7986bbaee8940da11ce089383521ab420c443ab7b15ed42aed91fd31ce833896) that contains instructions and a payload within another DLL via an encrypted blob (d3dcompiler_47.dll – SHA256: 11be1803e2e307b647a8a7e02d128335c448ff741bf06bf52b332e0bbf423b03).
Shellcode tries to pull ICO files from GitHub that contain various URIs for download, where the payload is ultimately loaded and installed to the target environment.
Attack Vector: Code-level compromise leading to trojanization of the legitimate signed file.
Sideloads malicious DLL (ffmpeg.dll) in the Windows installer.
